title: NSW, QLD, VIC and more - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Network maintenance affecting NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas has finished. All services are now restored following the scheduled window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026. Normal service and order processing has resumed. Thank you for your patience while this work was completed.

updates.content:
Some services in NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas will be briefly offline while our network partner completes planned upgrades. A single interruption of up to 30 minutes is expected within the maintenance window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026.

Orders and service change requests may process more slowly during and shortly after the window.

Most services should reconnect automatically. If your service does not come back online after the window, please restart your modem/router and contact our support team. We appreciate your patience while this work is completed.

The planned network maintenance affecting NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas has been rescheduled by our network partner. The maintenance window is now scheduled for 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Wednesday 30 September 2026, and some services may be offline for up to 6 hours during this time. Order and service processing may also be delayed until maintenance is complete. Maintenance work has not yet started.

The planned network maintenance affecting some services in NSW, QLD, VIC, and other areas has been rescheduled. The maintenance window is now set for 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026. During this time, affected services may experience a single interruption of up to 30 minutes, and order and service processing may be delayed until maintenance is complete. Maintenance work has not yet started.

Network maintenance has now commenced in NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas. Services may be briefly offline during the scheduled window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026. You may notice brief interruptions and some order or service processing delays while this work takes place.

Network maintenance in NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas has been completed as scheduled during the maintenance window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026. All affected services have been restored, and normal service and order processing has resumed.

The scheduled network maintenance affecting NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas was completed during the planned window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026. All affected services have been restored and normal operations have resumed. Thank you for your patience.
